🛡️ Simple Tips to Prevent Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) 🛡️

🧼 Wash hands often
🤧 Avoid close contact
🚫 Don’t touch your face
🏠 Stay home if sick
🧴 Disinfect surfaces
😷 Wear a mask in crowds
#StaySafe #HMPVPrevention #HealthTips #Raminfo http
